display.purpose: App title and highest-level product context.

eyebrow.purpose: Rare context labels such as phase or mode.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Soft structural lift for major shells only.

motion.name: ease-out-product
motion.purpose: Recommended easing for future non-layout transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Motion must be optional and never required to understand progress.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary workflow action such as sign in, save source, upload source, or create exam job.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80)); background: var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, oklch(0.49 0.11 198)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action for refresh, open, reveal, or low-risk state changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); background: var(--surface-muted, oklch(0.968 0.009 200)); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 35%, var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82))); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard text input for titles, certification target, and configuration.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-title">Title</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-title" placeholder="AWS networking notes" />
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--text-soft, oklch(0.49 0.018 220)); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80)); color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); padding: 11px 12px; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 28%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)); }

components.name: Workspace Tabs
components.description: Compact navigation across Sources, Generate, Review, and History.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Workspace views"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Sources</button><button class="ds-tab">Generate</button><button class="ds-tab">Review</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-tab { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); background: var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80)); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80)); background: var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)); border-color: transparent; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Card
components.description: Selectable source material row with status and ready-state action.
components.html:
FDM Volume 1

FILE PDF | READY
components.css: .ds-source-card { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80)); padding: 16px; color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); } .ds-source-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-source-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--text-soft, oklch(0.49 0.018 220)); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-action { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); background: var(--surface-muted, oklch(0.968 0.009 200)); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Review Choice
components.description: Interactive answer option that supports selected, correct, and incorrect states.
components.html: <button class="ds-choice">A. Use one selected source for each generated exam.</button>
components.css: .ds-choice { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text, oklch(0.285 0.02 240)); background: var(--surface-muted, oklch(0.968 0.009 200)); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 45%, var(--border, oklch(0.88 0.012 82))); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 9%, var(--surface, oklch(0.992 0.004 80))); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, oklch(0.58 0.105 198)) 32%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like a clean, well-lit study surface: calm, organized, and precise. The product is not trying to entertain the user. It is helping an individual learner turn trusted source material into focused certification practice.
keyCharacteristics: One clear primary action per workflow moment.
Interactive review states that feel deliberate, not game-like.
Technical depth on demand, never as the default screen.

rules.name: The Teal Earns Attention Rule
rules.body: Study Teal is for action, selection, and progress. Do not spread it across decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Paper Before Panels Rule
rules.body: Use tonal contrast first. Add borders and shadows only when the user needs structural separation.

rules.name: The Study Voice Rule
rules.body: Use direct labels and short sentences. Do not make headings repeat the paragraph below them.

rules.name: The Calm Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight and spacing before dramatic type size jumps. This is a product workspace, not a landing page hero.

rules.name: The Desk Surface Rule
rules.body: If a container looks like a floating SaaS card, it is too elevated. Reduce the shadow, rely on the border, or use tonal separation.

dos: Do show selected source material clearly before generation.
Do keep the Sources, Generate, Review, and History path visible and predictable.
Do use Study Teal only for action, active state, and selection.
Do keep technical details available behind disclosure controls.
Do use keyboard-visible focus states on buttons, tabs, inputs, choices, and summaries.
Do keep motion reduced-motion friendly and limited to opacity, transform, or color transitions.
donts: Don't use generic AI SaaS layouts with excessive gradients, glass effects, or repeated identical cards.
Don't turn Dribbble or Behance polish into decorative concept UI that weakens the workflow.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe card borders, or glassmorphism as default styling.
Don't hide source status or selected materials when the user is about to generate an exam.
